# BirthdayGen

> BirthdayGen (https://birthday.nirbhay.online) is a free web-based personalized birthday website maker and interactive digital greeting card generator. Users can create a personalized interactive celebration page with custom photos, ambient music, heartfelt personal messages, and real-time microphone-powered virtual candle blowing. Shareable on WhatsApp with one tap. Zero signup required.

For the comprehensive documentation and full directory of programmatic resources, see [llms-full.txt](https://birthday.nirbhay.online/llms-full.txt).

## Core Interactive Features
- **Virtual Candle Blowing**: Uses the browser's Web Audio API to detect microphone blowing input, extinguishing digital candle flames in real time accompanied by festive confetti and celebration sound effects.
- **Photo Memories Gallery**: Multi-photo interactive slideshow showcasing personal moments and memories.
- **Celebratory Music**: Built-in royalty-free celebratory background tracks (Classic Happy Birthday, Music Box, Upbeat Party Pop).
- **8 Free Visual Themes**: Royal Gold, Midnight Stars, Princess Fairytale, Unicorn Kids, Fun & Colorful, Elegant Classic, Retro Neon Arcade, and Modern Minimal.
- **WhatsApp Ready**: Generates a lightweight, mobile-optimized URL with rich OpenGraph preview cards for WhatsApp, iMessage, and social media.
- **Privacy First**: No account registration or personal data harvesting. Created pages remain active for 30 days (or renewable for annual celebrations).

## Main Application Pages
- [Birthday Website Maker / Generator](https://birthday.nirbhay.online/#create): The interactive tool to build and generate a personalized birthday celebration page.
- [Birthday Wishes & Quotes Library](https://birthday.nirbhay.online/wishes): Curated collection of 100+ heartfelt, funny, romantic, and milestone birthday messages.
- [Wishes by Milestone Age](https://birthday.nirbhay.online/ages): Age-specific birthday wishes and ideas (16th, 18th, 21st, 25th, 30th, 40th, 50th, 60th, and beyond).
- [Premium Keepsake Universe](https://birthday.nirbhay.online/premium): Cinematic multi-act anniversary, birthday, and romantic celebration experiences with wax-sealed letters.

- [Best Friend Birthday Wishes](https://birthday.nirbhay.online/wishes/best-friend): Meaningful, loyal, and funny messages for best friends.

- [Funny Birthday Wishes](https://birthday.nirbhay.online/wishes/funny): Lighthearted and playful birthday jokes and quotes.
- [Mom Birthday Wishes](https://birthday.nirbhay.online/wishes/mom): Warm, grateful tributes and quotes for mothers.
- [Dad Birthday Wishes](https://birthday.nirbhay.online/wishes/dad): Respectful, loving messages for fathers.
- [Sister Birthday Wishes](https://birthday.nirbhay.online/wishes/sister): Affectionate and funny greetings for sisters.
- [Brother Birthday Wishes](https://birthday.nirbhay.online/wishes/brother): High-energy and warm messages for brothers.
- [Belated Birthday Wishes](https://birthday.nirbhay.online/wishes/belated): Thoughtful and humorous late birthday greetings.
